C1263.title: Moxie Marlinspike Discloses the SSLStrip Attack at Black Hat DC
C1263.summary: In February 2009, Moxie Marlinspike presented the SSLStrip tool and attack method at Black Hat DC. The technique exploits the initial HTTP visit before a site redirects a user to HTTPS. A man-in-the-middle prevents that upgrade, maintains an HTTPS connection to the server, and serves HTTP to the victim, exposing credentials and communications that would otherwise be protected by TLS.
